component.title: ArrayField
component.purpose: An ordered repeating field that keeps editing, constraints, and item actions understandable at any viewport.

states.description: An existing collection exposes in-place editing and predictable item actions.
An empty collection offers a clear first action and explains why it is empty.

claims.statement: Move, duplicate, and remove actions are native buttons with names that identify the item they affect.
Minimum and maximum item constraints remain visible and do not silently discard user values.
Item controls reflow below the control at narrow widths without document overflow.
